bit_fields.description: FIFO threshold. This bit is set and cleared by software.

bit_fields.description: FIFO flush. This bit is set by software. It is always read low.

bit_fields.name: TRIS
bit_fields.description: Tristate management on data line. This bit is set and cleared by software.

bit_fields.description: Mute. This bit is set and cleared by software.
